android_mechanism: Suggested-version query does nested/unindexed scans; fix uses a better index/access path
bug_description: Reading a random classic poem executes 'select * from classicalliterature_classicpoem where id = (select p.id from classicalliterature_classicpoem p order by random() limit 1)', which materializes and sorts every row of the poem table (thousands of rows with long text fields) on each refresh. The classic-poem page runs this query on page entry and on every toolbar refresh tap, so its latency grows linearly with dataset size.
fix_summary: The random pick uses a random id range scan on the primary key (where id >= abs(random()) % max(id) ... order by id limit 1), an O(log n) indexed lookup instead of a full-table sort.
trigger_steps: Install the app, import the classic-poem dataset via settings (数据同步) so the table holds thousands of rows.
Start hitrace capture (categories: app, sched, disk, database).
Navigate to the classic-poem page (随机一首) and tap the refresh toolbar action 10 times.
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Wall time of each random-poem SELECT execution (from query start to resultSet ready, visible in database/disk trace activity and hilog), averaged over 10 refreshes.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed query time grows with row count (full scan + sort of N rows); fixed is near-constant. With >= 5000 rows, unfixed_avg_ms > fixed_avg_ms by >= 5x.

oracle_revision.reason: The definition is the duration of the random-read query as timed by the probe between the OHMB markers, i.e. elapsed_ms.
oracle_revision.note: Renamed only. The definition, comparison rule and every recorded measurement are unchanged; no number changed meaning.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 20 app sched disk database -o /data/local/tmp/jingmo_random.chtrace
